ambiguities.description: The action applies to HPT 1st-stage disks listed in Table 1 to paragraph (g)(1). That table is printed only as an image, so it cannot be confirmed that it matches the S/Ns printed in paragraph (c)(1) or that it holds only P/N 2A5001.
readings: Table 1 lists the same seven P/N 2A5001 disks as paragraph (c)(1).
Table 1 lists a different or partial set, and only the table decides which disks need the USI.

ambiguities.description: The action applies to HPT 2nd-stage disks listed in Table 2 to paragraph (g)(2). That table is printed only as an image, so it cannot be confirmed that it matches the S/Ns printed in paragraph (c)(2) or that it holds only P/N 2A4802.
readings: Table 2 lists the same eight P/N 2A4802 disks as paragraph (c)(2).
Table 2 lists a different or partial set, and only the table decides which disks need the USI.

governing_document.reason: Final rule (Amendment 39-21626). The thread has no proposed rule or correction, so its regulatory text controls.

notes: Paragraph (b) states no affected ADs. The preamble mentions Emergency AD 2020-07-51 (85 FR 20402) only as background. The regulatory text states no relationship with it.
The preamble describes this AD as interim action; the root cause is still under investigation.
The preamble estimates 2 engines of U.S. registry affected.

The procedures for the USI are NMSB V2500-ENG-72-0713, Revision 1, Accomplishment Instructions paragraphs 6 (1st-stage disk) and 7 (2nd-stage disk). These are procedure-only and are not recorded as dependencies.
The service information was approved for incorporation by reference as of July 13, 2021 (paragraph (k)(3)).

required_actions.description: For affected engines with an installed HPT 1st-stage disk listed in Table 1 to paragraph (g)(1), within 10 flight cycles after the effective date, perform a USI of the HPT 1st-stage disk using the Accomplishment Instructions, paragraph 6, of IAE NMSB V2500-ENG-72-0713, Revision 1.

unrecorded_conditions.description: Whether the USI of the HPT 1st-stage disk has already been done (paragraph (f): 'unless already done').

required_actions.description: For affected engines with an installed HPT 2nd-stage disk listed in Table 2 to paragraph (g)(2), within 10 flight cycles after the effective date, perform a USI of the HPT 2nd-stage disk using the Accomplishment Instructions, paragraph 7, of IAE NMSB V2500-ENG-72-0713.

unrecorded_conditions.description: Whether the USI of the HPT 2nd-stage disk has already been done (paragraph (f): 'unless already done').

required_actions.description: If, during the USI required by paragraph (g)(1), an HPT 1st-stage disk does not pass the USI as specified in the Accomplishment Instructions, paragraph 8, of IAE NMSB V2500-ENG-72-0713, Revision 1, then before further flight remove the disk from service and replace it with a part eligible for installation.

trigger.condition: HPT 1st-stage disk does not pass the USI required by paragraph (g)(1) as specified in the Accomplishment Instructions, paragraph 8, of IAE NMSB V2500-ENG-72-0713, Revision 1

unrecorded_conditions.description: Whether the HPT 1st-stage disk failed the USI required by paragraph (g)(1) (pass criteria in NMSB V2500-ENG-72-0713, paragraph 8).

required_actions.description: If, during the USI required by paragraph (g)(2), an HPT 2nd-stage disk does not pass the USI as specified in the Accomplishment Instructions, paragraph 8, of IAE NMSB V2500-ENG-72-0713, Revision 1, then before further flight remove the disk from service and replace it with a part eligible for installation.

trigger.condition: HPT 2nd-stage disk does not pass the USI required by paragraph (g)(2) as specified in the Accomplishment Instructions, paragraph 8, of IAE NMSB V2500-ENG-72-0713, Revision 1

unrecorded_conditions.description: Whether the HPT 2nd-stage disk failed the USI required by paragraph (g)(2) (pass criteria in NMSB V2500-ENG-72-0713, paragraph 8).
